_comment: Fan Coins (docs/channel.md §29, version 2 §29.6; the numbers in config/settings.json fanCoins). chants: what a viewer can have one end sing, each sung by the crowd's voices (soundRecipes.js 'chant'): its tune, a syllable at a time: "vowel note seconds" (ah, eh, oh or oo, its note in semitones above the chant's root; a ! before the vowel shouts it, short and breathy), "* seconds" a clap of every hand, "- seconds" a breath; no tune is the crowd's own olé. lines: what the speech bubble shows, a line at a time, each line's syllables (claps and breaths too) in order; the end waves its arms through each line. pictures: FAN BOARD's and the ticker's words (Tom: the same for both), the general ones, then teamWords for each team ({team} its short name). shouts: the fan shout's words (Tom's notes, task 3), {team} the end's team, {star} its top scorer this season so far (left out while it has none), ♥ drawn as a pixel heart.

chants.words: HERE WE GO, HERE WE GO, HERE WE GO!
